subtitle: Prayer times, Qibla, mosques
promo: Prayer times, the Qibla and the nearest mosque in one calm app, with an optional sky that follows the weather. Adhan, widgets, answers with sources. No ads, no account.
promo_tv: Today's prayer times on your TV, the Qibla for your city and the mosques nearby. A full-screen alert at each prayer. No ads, no account.
whats_new: New: Near Mosque on Apple Watch, with complications, the Qibla compass and the tasbih. One style for everything. Pick it in Settings and the app's buttons, every widget, the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island follow it. New widget looks: teal and time of day.
whats_new_other: One style for everything. Pick it in Settings and the app's buttons and highlights follow it. New looks: teal and time of day.
intro: Near Mosque shows today's prayer times for your city, points you to the Qibla, and finds the mosques around you. Prayer times and the Qibla are worked out on your device, so they work without internet.
prayer: The next prayer and the time left, on a sky that follows the time of day

Sky follows the weather (optional): see today's weather in your prayer city on the sky above the prayer times, with the temperature and the wind. It stays off until you turn it on; then the city's location, rounded to about 1 km, is sent to MET Norway. Weather data: MET Norway (CC BY 4.0).
11 calculation methods, standard or Hanafi Asr, Hijri date and minute adjustments for each prayer
Adhan from Masjid al-Haram or Al-Masjid an-Nabawi, reminders before each prayer, and a Fajr alarm
qibla_live: A compass that turns with your phone and tells you when you face the Kaaba
The bearing and the distance to Makkah from your city
qibla_north: The direction of the Qibla from north for your city
mosques: Mosques around you on a map or a compass, with their distance and walking directions
Mosques are searched online, and the app also carries mosque data for Cairo, London and Cape Town
ask: Ask a question and read the answer from the app's library, with the source of every passage
Your questions stay on your device. Answers quote books and are not a fatwa.
library: Fatwas of Sheikh Ibn Baz, hadith, Quran translations and tafsir, and IslamHouse books
Classical Arabic books of creed, hadith, fiqh, tafsir and sirah, each downloaded once and read offline
widgets_ios: 10 widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen, a countdown in the Dynamic Island, and a Qibla button in Control Center
One style for the app and every widget: gold and cream, green, night sky, teal or time of day
Ask Siri when the next prayer is or where the nearest mosque is
watch: Prayer times, a live countdown and reminders on your wrist, with complications for your watch face and the Smart Stack
A Qibla compass that taps your wrist when you face it, a tasbih on the Digital Crown, nearby mosques and common answers by voice; works without your iPhone too
widgets_mac: 10 widgets for your desktop and Notification Center
One style for the app and every widget: gold and cream, green, night sky, teal or time of day
also_ios: iPad, Mac, Apple TV (a prayer board for your home or mosque hall) and Apple Vision Pro.
also_mac: iPhone, iPad, Apple TV and Apple Vision Pro.
also_vision: iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV.
privacy: No account, no ads, no tracking. The app goes online only to search for mosques (with your location rounded), to show the map, to download what you ask for, to open links you choose, and, if you turn on "Sky follows the weather", to get the weather for your city.
privacy_policy_text: Near Mosque has no account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Prayer times and the Qibla are worked out on your device, and we run no server for the app, so nothing about you reaches us. The app goes online only to search for mosques, show maps, download what you choose and open links you pick. On iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro, the optional "Sky follows the weather" is off until you turn it on; it then sends your city's location, rounded to about 1 km, to MET Norway to get the weather. The Apple TV app does not use it. Full privacy policy: https://nearmosque.net/privacy.html
